user.title: Eversource Rates
user.description: Configure public Eversource electricity tariff rates for your service territory. Natural gas rates are not supported.

rate_class.title: Electric rate class
rate_class.description: Select the electric rate class shown on your Eversource bill. It is typically listed in the detailed Delivery section.

supply_plan.title: Supply plan
supply_plan.description: Select your Eversource Basic Service supply plan. Fixed changes twice per year; Monthly Variable changes monthly.

service_area.title: Service area
service_area.description: Select your Eastern Massachusetts service area. Energy Efficiency charges differ between Greater Boston / Cambridge / South Shore and Cape Cod / Martha's Vineyard.
